post.description:
Poll any not acknowledged events for the client system.
This method does not require, that the client system fills {@link SyncEventsRequestDTO#syncId}.
However, it requires, that a call to {@link #acknowledgeEvents(AcknowledgeEventsRequestDTO)} is done for acknowledge of the events.
Since XNSG 4.0, Nov. FP, 2017

Poll the next events for the client system.
This method requires the client system to persist the synchronisation state itself and passing a proper value for {@link SyncEventsRequestDTO#syncId}
See {@link #getNotAcknowledgedEvents(SyncEventsRequestDTO)} for a version of the method, were the syncronisation state is kept within the Engine.

 The search will deliver the same results that would be obtained when a search term (reference number) would be entered in the quick search application GUI (located in the assistent pane of the Assist4Monitoring & Alerting desktop). Set the state of a message (got with getShippingOrder) to "OK", "ERROR" or "RETRY".

name.description:
Name of this field, i.e. the role the field plays in the enclosing record.

When the same name is repeated in the context of the same parent record, it is assumed that the parent defines this element as a repeatable (array) element.

value.description:
Value of the field.

The format follows the conventions of xml schema encoding, see http://www.w3.org/TR/xmlschema-2/.

Currently implemented formats:

  • string - the plain string
  • int - digits base10, +-2^31
  • long - digits base10, +-2^63
  • decimal - +-123456.789
  • boolean - the literals 'true' and 'false'
  • dateTime - yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss
  • base64Binary - binary data in base64 encoding

type.description:

This is not strictly necessary since the receiving entity should be able to infer the structure with its own meta data; it may be used however for sanity checks.

The format follows the conventions of xml schema encoding, see http://www.w3.org/TR/xmlschema-2/.

Currently implemented formats:

  • string
  • int
  • long
  • decimal
  • boolean
  • dateTime
  • base64Binary

Synchronization ID for delta-transmission.

Use this syncId in subsequent calls to {@link ISyncBF#synchronizeEvents(SyncEventsRequestDTO)} to enabledelta-transmission of changes.

However, this syncId may be null if no events are found an the field {@link SyncEventsResponseDTO#events} is an empty array. In this case usethe last NOT NULL syncId returned in this field for subsequent calls to {@link ISyncBF#synchronizeEvents(SyncEventsRequestDTO)}.

If the user is found either in the system's user management or in a connected LDAP directory, the request runs under this user's roles.

If the user is not found, the request is only granted the basic 'I_EVERYONE' role. The user name may be used for logging purposes in this case.

referenceField.description:
ReferenceField, possible values are
  • CONS_NO (Consignment number)
  • SHIPPER_REFERENCE (Reference number of the shipper for the forwarder)
  • GLOB_TRANS_NO (Global transaction number of a transport leg)
  • INTERNAL_ID (Internal database id. Only to be used for internal purposes)
  • FORWARDER_REFERENCE (Reference number by which the shipment can be found on the tracking website of the forwarder)
  • MASTER_WAYBILL (Waybill number as a unique number for the process within the organisation of the forwarder)
  • HOUSE_WAYBILL (Waybill number distributed by forwarder for one consignee, usually not known to the supplier)
  • MEANS_OF_TRANSPORT_NO (Registration number of the means of transport)
  • GLOB_UNIT_NO (Global transport unit number)
  • SUPPLIER_GLN (Global location number of the supplier. Can only be used in combination with other references fields)
  • HANDLING_UNIT_NUMBER_FROM (The handling unit number from of a handling unit. Can only be used in combination with other references fields, e.g. CONS_NO)
  • DELIVERY_NOTE_NUMBER (Deliverynotenumber of a handling unit)
  • SHIPPING_CONTAINER_CODE (Serial shipping container code for a handling unit)
  • DATA_SOURCE_ID_HOST (DataSourceIDHost or transacation ID. The Id of the object in the host system)
  • TRANSPORT_SEQUENCE_NUMBER (The sequence number of the transport )
  • ORDER_NO_BUYER (Order number buyer. Not to be used together with ORDER_NO or ORDER_NO_SUPPLIER)
  • ORDER_NO_SUPPLIER (Order number supplier. Not to be used together with ORDER_NO or ORDER_NO_BUYER)
  • BUYER_GLN (Global location number of the buyer. Can only be used in combination with other references fields)
  • SEQUENCE_NUMBER (Sequence number by which a transport leg can be found in combination with other numbers)
  • ORDER_NO (Order number. To be used when the type type of order number is unknown. It might be order number buyer or supplier. If the type of order number is known, use ORDER_NO_BUYER or ORDER_NO_SUPPLIER instead.
    Not to be used together with ORDER_NO_BUYER or ORDER_NO_SUPPLIER)
  • ORDERITEM_NO (Order item number. To be used when the type type of order item number is unknown. It might be order item number buyer or supplier. Only to be used together with ORDER_NO)
  • ORDERITEM_NO_BUYER (Order item number buyer.
    Only to be used together with ORDER_NO_BUYER)
  • ORDERITEM_NO_SUPPLIER (Order item number buyer
    Only to be used together with ORDER_NO_SUPPLIER)
  • HU_SHIPPER_REFERENCE (Handling unit reference number of the shipper for the forwarder)
  • HU_MASTER_WAYBILL_NUMBER (Waybill number for a handling unit)
It depends on the trackingObjectType which field makes sense.

ReferenceField can hold one of the constants REF_FIELD-XYZ constants. It depends on the trackingEventType which field makes sense. > Valid values: > `ORDER_NO`: To be used when the type type of order number is unknown. It might be order number buyer or supplier. If the type of order number is known, use `ORDER_NO_BUYER` or `ORDER_NO_SUPPLIER` instead.
Not to be used together with `ORDER_NO_BUYER` or `ORDER_NO_SUPPLIER`. > `ORDER_NO_BUYER`: Order number buyer (`ORDER_NO_BUYER`)
Not to be used together with `ORDER_NO` or `ORDER_NO_SUPPLIER`. > `ORDER_NO_SUPPLIER`: Order number supplier (`ORDER_NO_SUPPLIER`)
Not to be used together with `ORDER_NO` or `ORDER_NO_BUYER`. > `ORDERITEM_NO`: Order item number (`ORDERITEM_NO`). To be used when the type type of order item number is unknown. It might be order item number buyer or supplier. Only to be used together with `ORDER_NO`. > `ORDERITEM_NO_BUYER`: Order item number buyer (`ORDERITEM_NO_BUYER`)
Only to be used together with `ORDER_NO_BUYER`. > `ORDERITEM_NO_SUPPLIER`: Order item number buyer (`ORDERITEM_NO_SUPPLIER`)
Only to be used together with `ORDER_NO_SUPPLIER`. > `SHIPPER_REFERENCE`: Reference number of the shipper for the forwarder (`SHIPPER_REFERENCE`). > `FORWARDER_REFERENCE`: Reference number by which the shipment can be found on the tracking website of the forwarder (`FORWARDER_REFERENCE`). > `MASTER_WAYBILL`: Waybill number as a unique number for the process within the organisation of the forwarder (`MASTER_WAYBILL`). > `HOUSE_WAYBILL`: Waybill number distributed by forwarder for one consignee, usually not known to the supplier (`HOUSE_WAYBILL`). > `MEANS_OF_TRANSPORT_NO`: Registration number of the means of transport (`MEANS_OF_TRANSPORT_NO`). > `CONS_NO`: Consignment number (`CONS_NO`). > `GLOB_TRANS_NO`: Global transaction number of a transport leg (`GLOB_TRANS_NO`). > `SUPPLIER_GLN`: Global location number of the supplier. Can only be used in combination with other references fields. > `BUYER_GLN`: Global location number of the buyer. Can only be used in combination with other references fields. > `FORWARDER_GLN`: Global location number of the forwarder of a LISHUTransportLeg (`FORWARDER_GLN`). > `HU_NUMBER_FROM`: Handling unit number from of a handling unit (`HU_NUMBER_FROM`). > `DELIVERY_NOTE_NUMBER`: Deliverynotenumber of a handling unit (`DELIVERY_NOTE_NUMBER`). > `GLOBAL_UNIT_NUMBER`: Global unit number of a handling unit (`GLOBAL_UNIT_NUMBER`). > `HU_MASTER_WAYBILL_NUMBER`: Waybill number for a handling unit (`HU_MASTER_WAYBILL_NUMBER`). > `SHIPPING_CONTAINER_CODE`: Serial shipping container code for a handling unit (`SHIPPING_CONTAINER_CODE`). > `HU_SHIPPER_REFERENCE`: Handling unit reference number of the shipper for the forwarder (`HU_SHIPPER_REFERENCE`). > `CARRIER_REFERENCE`: Reference number by which a transport leg can be found in the organisation of the carrier (`CARRIER_REFERENCE`). > `SEQUENCE_NUMBER`: Sequence number by which a transport leg can be found in combination with other numbers (`SEQUENCE_NUMBER`). > `DATA_SOURCE_ID_HOST`: DataSourceIDHost or transacation ID (`DATA_SOURCE_ID_HOST`). The Id of the object in the host system. > `INTERNAL_ID`: Internal database id (`INTERNAL_ID`). Only to be used for internal purposes.
